narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Angles are only for corners, so they cannot describe a turn.
<bookmark mark='open'/>But the clock hand makes a corner with its starting line when it turns.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A turn from one line to another always opens an angle between them.
